expected: Accept a post-click extension sidepanel document materialized at one new target ID after the old panel is destroyed, with matching final target, replacement worker, opened request, exact extension context and actual post-reload Data continuity; retain direct creation-event proof where observed.
actual: The follow-up native run proved the correlated-panel repair in product, but the verifier rejected its pre-click and click entries sharing one millisecond despite strict recorded order. All three lifecycle boundaries can share a clock tick while their array indices establish order.
severity: S2: normal oracle blocks T03 adjudication after a successful native product run; no product defect established.
cause: The verifier required strict Date.parse inequality across three already strictly ordered trace edges. Millisecond timestamp quantization collapsed real adjacent events into equal instants; the nondecreasing clock and array order remain independent evidence.
sibling_census: The same reload producer serves other native paths. This repair is restricted to the member Data T03 verifier; other acceptance policies are unchanged.
fix: At pre-click→click, click→old-panel destruction, and destruction→first replacement-panel observation, allow equal finite timestamps only when the existing strict array-index checks establish order. Retain nondecreasing global clock, finite timestamps, identity/type/ownership checks, dropped-entry refusal, contradictory-event flags, and all normal T03 eligibility gates.
